movelist.name: U-Turn
movelist.effect: If U-Turn successfully hits its target, the user deals damage and then immediately is returned to its Poké Ball in the same turn. A New Pokémon may immediately be sent out. Using U-Turn lets a Trapped user be recalled.

movelist.name: Grass Knot
movelist.effect: Grass Knot’s Damage Base is equal to twice the target’s Weight Class.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Leaf Guard’s Frequency is ignored if used during Sunny Weather.

abilities.name: Blessed Touch
abilities.effect: An adjacent Pokémon or Trainer gains Hit Points equal to 1/4th of its maximum Hit Points.

abilities.name: Combo Striker
abilities.trigger: The user rolls a natural 1, 10, or 11 on an attack roll
abilities.effect: After the triggering attack is resolved, the user may use a Struggle Attack as a Free Action. Note: Yes, Struggle Attacks made due to Combo Striker may trigger Combo Striker.
